import { stripTypeScriptTypes } from 'node:module';
import { init } from '../browser/lane.ts';
import type { Spec } from '../browser/spec.ts';
export { render } from '../browser/lane.ts';

/** Uses every import. */
export function strip(spec: Spec): string {
  init(spec);
  return stripTypeScriptTypes('const x: number = 1;');
}
